cases.prompt: Threat model the design in docs/upload-design.md before we build it.
expectations: Identifies assets, actors, and trust boundaries (browser, API, S3, admin panel, thumbnail job)

Flags the client-controlled customerId (customers can attach files to other customers), the user-controlled S3 key from filename (overwrite and path issues), and long-lived presigned URLs shared by email
Flags malicious file processing by ImageMagick and the missing malware scanning and content-type validation
Ranks threats and proposes concrete mitigations, and does not modify files

cases.prompt: What could go wrong security-wise with our password reset flow in src/reset.js?
expectations: Invokes kit-threat-model or gives an equivalent structured threat analysis
Flags the predictable MD5-of-email-and-time token, tokens that never expire and are not single-use, and account enumeration through the 404 message
Flags missing rate limiting and that the password is stored without hashing, and proposes mitigations

cases.prompt: Audit src/ for vulnerabilities and report findings with severity.
